game.name: Skylanders Swap Force (Europe)(Es,It)
game.desc: Skylanders SWAP Force on Xbox 360 is an action/platformer game. It is based on the concept of interchangeability, allowing children to swap the upper and lower halves of Skylanders toys to create their own characters. This means that the characters' powers and moves can be mixed and matched and then brought back to life in the game. The players' quest is to explore the Cloudbreak Islands to defeat Kaos.
